passage.text: Nam, how do I make a video call on my new phone?
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈmeɪk ə ˈvɪdioʊ ˌkɔːl ɑːn maɪ ˈnuː ˈfoʊn?

passage.text: I want to see your face, not only your messages!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈsiː jʊr ˈfeɪs, ˈnɑːt ˈoʊnli jʊr ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz!

passage.text: It's easy! First, open our family chat.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈiːzi! ˈfɜːrst, ˈoʊpən aʊər ˈfæməli ˌtʃæt.

passage.text: Wait a moment, and you'll see my face.
passage.reading: ˈweɪt ə ˈmoʊmənt, ənd juːl ˈsiː maɪ ˈfeɪs.

passage.text: I pressed the button, but I can only see my ear!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈprɛst ðə ˈbʌtən, bʌt aɪ kən ˈoʊnli ˈsiː maɪ ˈɪr!

passage.text: Oh, I moved the phone in front of my face, and now I can see you!
passage.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈmuːvd ðə ˈfoʊn ɪn ˈfrʌnt əv maɪ ˈfeɪs, ənd ˈnaʊ aɪ kən ˈsiː juː!

passage.text: Thank you, Nam. I love video calls!
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈnɑːm. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈvɪdioʊ ˌkɔːlz!
